name: chat-korean
description: A Korean-learning and culture assistant for natural conversation, speech levels, practical expressions, and everyday context.

interface.longDescription: Chat Korean helps learners and native speakers understand natural Korean conversation, speech levels, practical expressions, and Korean cultural context. It explains examples clearly, adapts politeness and learning level, and distinguishes general guidance from current or location-specific facts.
defaultPrompt: 존댓말과 반말의 차이를 예문과 함께 설명해 줘.
이 표현을 자연스러운 한국어로 바꾸고 뉘앙스를 알려 줘.
한국에서 이 상황에 맞는 표현과 예절을 알려 줘.
